forbidden: Referencing any non-VITE_PUBLIC_ prefixed env var under apps/web/src
Adding SSR, Next.js patterns, or any server-rendering dependency
useEffect-based data fetching (TanStack Query is the only server-state mechanism)
Redefining a shared interface/DTO/zod schema instead of importing from packages/types
Rendering a raw error message or stack trace to the user
agents.definitionOfDone: Feature implemented end-to-end against a real apps/api contract from packages/types; Playwright e2e spec added; docs/features/*.md updated (§12 template); three-pass manual test log completed; zero non-VITE_PUBLIC_ env references; lint/typecheck/build green.

forbidden: Adding any /api/jobs/* endpoint or any route whose only caller is a scheduler (ADR-007)
Performing per-request ML inference inline in a route handler (ADR-002)
Returning a raw error, stack trace, or internal path in an HTTP response
Skipping the middleware chain order documented in docs/standards/backend.md
Using a wildcard (*) CORS origin or matching origins with an unbounded regex on write routes
Holding a long-lived direct Postgres connection instead of the Supavisor pooler
agents.definitionOfDone: Route implemented with zod validation on entry, wrapped in withErrorBoundary(), covered by Vitest tests (success, failure, auth, CORS, rate-limit paths); docs/features/*.md updated; STRIDE vectors considered for any write-path change.

forbidden: Adding a geometry column without a GiST index
Shipping a table with RLS disabled and no ADR justifying the exception
Diverging migration SQL from what docs/data-schema/schema.md documents
Hardcoding a threshold (e.g. radius bounds, risk bands) instead of matching the §14 constants registry value
Refreshing region_risk_summary without CONCURRENTLY once the unique index exists
agents.definitionOfDone: Migration applies cleanly from empty; every geometry column indexed; RLS enabled with policy matching rls-policies.md exactly; schema tests added (M6-T14); docs/data-schema/*.md kept in sync in the same PR.

forbidden: Randomly shuffled train/validation splits (walk-forward CV only, to avoid time-series leakage)
Auto-promoting a retrained model without human review of the model card diff
Shipping an ONNX artifact without a recorded SHA256 in ml/training/MODEL_MANIFEST.json
Hardcoding feature thresholds (e.g. temperature/humidity bands) instead of referencing the named §14 constant
Implementing per-request inference inside apps/api (ADR-002)
agents.definitionOfDone: Model meets the recall >= 0.85 / precision >= 0.60 gate on walk-forward CV; ONNX export < 2MB, checksum recorded; model card updated with the new version's metrics; feature-engineering.md matches the shipped feature code.

forbidden: continue-on-error or `|| true` on any test/lint/typecheck step
Exposing any cron/background job as an HTTP-triggered workflow step calling apps/api (ADR-007)
Hardcoding a real secret value in any workflow YAML
Using an unpinned (no version/SHA) third-party GitHub Action
Merging a deploy workflow that fails hard when a required secret is simply unconfigured, instead of no-oping safely
agents.definitionOfDone: Workflow YAML valid and version-pinned; the exact CI gate sequence (lint -> typecheck -> test -> build -> e2e) enforced with no bypass; docs/ci-cd.md updated with the workflow's trigger, steps, and required secrets.

forbidden: Approving a write-path or auth-adjacent PR with no STRIDE vectors filled in
Approving a PR where the three-pass manual test log is missing or unsigned for a write-path/LLM-touching change
Weakening a lint rule, test assertion, or manual-test description to force a gate green
Allowing a non-VITE_PUBLIC_ env reference to merge under apps/web/src
Signing off on a new table/policy without RLS enabled or an ADR exception
agents.definitionOfDone: Every R-rule in docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md §0.3 audited against the actual shipped code for the PR's scope, not just the plan; findings either fixed in the PR or explicitly tracked with an owner and reason.
